short_description.prompt: Write a short product description for {{name}} that highlights the main reason to buy it. Under 100 words. Plain prose, no headings or bullet lists.

description.prompt: Write a detailed product description for {{name}}. Open with a one-sentence hook. Follow with 4-6 bullet points covering the key features and benefits. Close with a short paragraph on use cases. Under 1000 words.

meta_title.prompt: Write an SEO meta title for the product {{name}}. Under 60 characters. Include the product name near the start. No quotes, no trailing punctuation.

meta_keyword.prompt: Write 5 to 10 SEO keywords for the product {{name}}, derived from its name and short description: {{short_description}}. Return a single comma-separated list. Lowercase. No duplicates, no hashtags, no trailing punctuation.

meta_description.prompt: Write an SEO meta description for the product {{name}} based on its short description: {{short_description}}. Between 140 and 160 characters. One sentence. Include a clear value proposition. No quotes.

advanced.system_prompt: Be a content generator, just reply with the content, skip all introductions.
